title: Australian Lamb Chops with Australian Bush Herbs
description: A traditional Australian lamb dish featuring lamb chops marinated in a mixture of bush herbs and spices, then baked to perfection.

ingredients.name: Australian Bush Herbs (Outback Blend)
ingredients.notes: Available at most health food stores

instructions: Rinse the lamb chops and pat them dry with a paper towel.
In a small bowl, mix together the Australian Bush Herbs, garlic, salt, and pepper.
Brush the lamb chops with olive oil and coat with the herb mixture, making sure they're evenly coated.
Place the lamb chops on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Bake the lamb chops in the preheated oven for 15-20 minutes or until they reach your desired level of doneness.
While the lamb chops are cooking, mix together the chopped rosemary and thyme.
Once the lamb chops are done, remove them from the oven and brush them with the balsamic vinegar (if using).
Sprinkle the rosemary and thyme mixture over the lamb chops and serve immediately.
Let the lamb chops rest for 5 minutes before serving.
